sinkhole.text: Imagine falling asleep in your own bed... and the ground beneath your bedroom opens up.
Seffner, Florida. February twenty-eighth, twenty thirteen. Around eleven at night.
The family was getting ready for bed, when a loud crash rang out.
Jeremy Bush ran to his brother Jeff's bedroom... and the room was gone.
Jeff, and everything in his room, had dropped into a hole thirty feet wide.
Jeremy jumped in, digging desperately, calling his brother's name.
But the floor kept collapsing. A sheriff's deputy reached in, and pulled him out.
So how does the ground just... vanish?
Much of Florida sits on limestone, and rainwater slowly eats it away, leaving hidden caverns.
The soil above can hold... until suddenly, it can't.
Rescuers searched, but the ground was too unstable. Jeff's body was never recovered.
And here's the haunting part. That same sinkhole has opened up again. Twice.
